'''Sonnds''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Hijado]]. Sonnds, like most [[Hijadoan]]s, was long-lived and was far more older than she appeared. When [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Parlay Thorp]] called attention to the apparent lack of elderly people among the Hijadoans, [[Noneen]] informed her that Sonnds was 140 years old.<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />
